headline: Lees-McRae still unbeaten with Young Harris to come
dek: Lees-McRae have won twelve matches and drawn three without defeat, and have conceded seven goals all season. They are the only side yet to lose a conference match, and Young Harris, top of the conference table, visit them on the final day.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Chowan's 43 goals have come from at least fifteen different scorers and have still brought four defeats; spreading the scoring has not bought a clean record.

wire.line: Erskine are now the only side in the conference without a win.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Thirteen matches dated before today carry no result at all, the earliest Converse's home match against Spartanburg Methodist and the latest Berry's home match against Shorter.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Francis Marion have won eleven matches, drawn two and lost three, and have conceded eleven goals in all.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Andre Camargo, a freshman, has scored ten goals and set up five for Chowan, from 32 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Edouard Laberge has made 77 saves for Emmanuel and conceded 22 goals, a save percentage of .778.

last_match.line: Lees-McRae remain the only side without a defeat; Shorter have not won since the opening day of conference play.

next_match.line: North Greenville come in on back-to-back wins; Converse have not lost to Lees-McRae, holding them level in both meetings.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
